scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:codec && npm run test:attention && npm run test:attention:optimized && npm run test:model:all
scripts.test:codec: npm run build && node scripts/test-webgpu.mjs && node scripts/test-phase2.mjs && python -m tests.oracles.verify_mixed
scripts.test:attention: npm run test:attention:baseline && node scripts/test-attention.mjs --compressed && python -m tests.oracles.verify_attention
scripts.test:attention:optimized: npm run build && node scripts/phase4-run.mjs optimized-test
scripts.bench:attention: python -m tests.oracles.export_attention --bench && npm run build && node scripts/phase4-run.mjs phase4-bench
scripts.bench:attention:baseline: python -m tests.oracles.export_attention --bench && npm run build && node scripts/benchmark-attention.mjs
scripts.test:model: npm run build && node scripts/model-browser.mjs model-test
scripts.test:model:compressed: npm run build && node scripts/model-browser.mjs model-compressed-test
scripts.test:model:codec: npm run build && node scripts/model-browser.mjs model-codec-test
scripts.test:model:live: npm run build && node scripts/model-browser.mjs model-live-test
scripts.test:model:all: npm run test:model && python -m tests.oracles.verify_model && npm run test:model:compressed && python -m tests.oracles.verify_model --compressed && npm run test:model:codec && npm run test:model:live && npm run build && node scripts/model-browser.mjs model-primitives
scripts.bench:model: npm run build && node scripts/model-browser.mjs model-benchmark
scripts.bench:model:decode: npm run build && node scripts/model-browser.mjs model-decode-benchmark
scripts.profile:attention: npm run build && node scripts/phase4-run.mjs profile
